Lakeside Ambulatory Surgery Center (fictional)
Colonoscopy report

Patient: Jamie Castellanos (fictional)
Synthetic record: SYN-GI-3007
Date of service: 2026-10-22
Place of service: Ambulatory surgery center
Endoscopist: Dr. Mei Tanaka, MD (fictional)

Procedure
Colonoscopy.

Indications
Surveillance colonoscopy for a personal history of adenomatous polyps; last colonoscopy in 2021.

Technique
The colonoscope was inserted into the rectum and advanced to the splenic flexure. Large amounts of solid stool were present throughout the left colon. Poor bowel preparation precluded safe advancement beyond the splenic flexure, and the procedure was terminated.

Findings
The visualized rectum, sigmoid colon and descending colon contained solid stool; no mass lesions were seen in the visualized mucosa.
The transverse colon, ascending colon and cecum were not examined.

Impression
Incomplete colonoscopy to the splenic flexure due to poor bowel preparation.

Recommendations
Repeat colonoscopy with an extended two-day bowel preparation in 4 to 6 weeks.
